title: feat(web): contextual AI actions in the hubs (phase 2.1)
body:
## Why

Per the Phase 2 direction: AI shouldn't be a separate "toy" page — it should appear as useful actions exactly where the user is working. This re-homes the standalone **AI Tools** capabilities into the relevant hub.

## What

A single reusable **`AiQuickAction`** component — a collapsed button that expands into a minimal form, calls the existing **synchronous** AI endpoint, and renders the result inline (clean, plain-language, copyable). Wired into:

| Hub | Action | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|
| **Prospects** | "Qualify a business with AI" → ICP-fit read, summary, angle, risks | `POST /api/ai/research` |
| **Outreach** (Campaigns) | "Draft a cold email with AI" → subject + body + follow-up, Copy all | `POST /api/ai/outreach` |
| **Inbox** | "Analyze a reply with AI" → summary, intent, suggested next action | `POST /api/ai/reply-analysis` |

**Inbox previously had no on-demand AI at all** (replies were only auto-classified by the worker on ingest) — this is the clearest new capability. Prospects/Outreach already have per-lead Research/Generate-Outreach in Leads; this is the complementary **ad-hoc** path for something not yet in the pipeline.

## Honoring the acceptance criteria

- **No DB changes**, nothing persisted — these are read-only AI calls.
- **No new backend routes** — reuses the three existing `/api/ai/*` endpoints.
- **No routes/pages deleted** — the standalone AI Tools page stays reachable; works with the hub-nav flag **on or off**.
- **Lightweight & contextual** — collapsed by default, minimal forms, inline results.
- Results render in plain language (consistent with the lead-brief styling), not raw JSON.

## Deferred (need new backend — flagged, not built)

`rewrite`, `improve CTA`, and `enrich company` require new AI endpoints + service functions. Held back to keep this PR lightweight; easy fast-follow if you want them.

## Tests

5 new (`AiQuickAction`: collapse/expand, required-field gating, research + reply run-and-render, API-error toast). Full web suite green (171), typecheck + eslint + production build clean.

## Next

Per your order: **review the hub groupings after dogfooding** before retiring any standalone pages.
